about: EN 1993-1-1 / EN 1993-1-8 worked examples transcribed from JRC report EUR 27346 (2015), 'Eurocodes: Background & Applications - Design of Steel Buildings - Worked examples' (source W1 in ../sources.md). 'published' = value printed in the report (comma decimals converted). 'derived' = the same formula recomputed in double precision from the published inputs (scratch script, node 2026-10-28); it is the gating reference because the report rounds intermediate factors (chi to 2 decimals) before the final product. Partial factors are those the report uses (gamma_M0 = gamma_M1 = 1.00, gamma_M2 = 1.25, the EN 1993-1-1 recommended values as the report states them); they are inputs of the case, not llull defaults.

cases.example: Section 2.1.8 - bolted connection of double angle 2 L80x6, S355, M20 class 6.8 full-thread, 5 bolts, gusset 8 mm, NEd = 580 kN, report pp. 95-97
clauses: EN 1993-1-8 3.10.3 (net section, per report 0.9 Anet fu / gammaM2)
errata: the same report (section 2.1, reproducing EN 1993-1-8 Table 3.4) gives alpha_v = 0.5 for classes 4.8, 5.8, 6.8 and 10.9 when the shear plane passes through the thread; the example uses 0.6 for a class 6.8 full-thread bolt
with alpha_v = 0.5, FvRd = 117.6 kN < FbRd_inner = 132.3 kN: shear governs the 3 inner bolts and the 5-bolt group gives 2 x 98.9 + 3 x 117.6 = 550.6 kN < NEd = 580 kN - the published verdict flips
cases.expectedLlull: FvRd 117.6 kN (alpha_v 0.5 named with its clause), group resistance 550.6 kN, verdict FAIL, utilisation 1.0534
